description: Source code for the MotionDetection plugin, implementing motion detection control and event handling within the WPEFramework platform.

classes.name: MotionDetection
classes.description: Main class implementing motion detection control, event handling, and JSON-RPC interface.

methods.name: MotionDetection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the plugin, registering RPC methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific motion detection components and registers event callback.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters RPC methods, and terminates platform-specific components.

methods.name: getMotionDetectors
methods.description: Retrieves list and info of available motion detectors.

methods.name: arm
methods.description: Arms a specified motion detector with given mode.

methods.name: isarmed
methods.description: Checks if a specified motion detector is armed.

methods.name: setNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Sets the no-motion period for a detector.

methods.name: getNoMotionPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current no-motion period for a detector.

methods.name: setSensitivity
methods.description: Sets the sensitivity level or name for a detector.

methods.name: getSensitivity
methods.description: Retrieves the current sensitivity setting of a detector.

methods.name: getLastMotionEventElapsedTime
methods.description: Returns time elapsed since last motion event.

methods.name: setMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Configures active periods for motion events.

methods.name: getMotionEventsActivePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves configured active periods for motion events.

methods.name: onMotionEvent
methods.description: Handles motion detection events and sends notifications.
